summary: Reproduced all three independent-review counterexamples at candidate commit a8b9c0fe45a4cc298d8ed84e52f8e956d5ae0f88, retained its valid split-marker and later-increment fixes, and corrected MiMo to drain every complete block in an increment, preserve text around tool calls in one-shot parsing, and flush unfinished buffered text at stream end. Parent candidate: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/pull/1966. Parent review: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/pull/2053.

tests.what_was_measured: Exact candidate behavior with three independent assertions: final-chunk trailing text, multiple calls and text in one increment, and one-shot surrounding-text preservation. All three failed before the correction; the candidate's four original tests passed.
Corrected MiMo behavior plus neighboring public parser behavior: 252 passed and 208 subtests passed, including equivalence at every two-chunk boundary of a two-call fixture.
Whitespace and all applicable repository hooks passed on the touched source and test files.
The two repository-wide unknown-tool forwarding and filtering tests remained passing.

gpu_execution.evidence: The defect and correction are deterministic pure-Python parser behavior exercised through MiMoDetector and FunctionCallParser; no model execution or GPU computation is involved.

remaining_limitations: No MiMo model weights or HTTP serving run was used, so model semantics, tokenizer delivery, and distributed serving were not evaluated.
The evidence qualifies parser and public end-of-stream behavior only; it does not claim architecture-specific model correctness.
